summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting on re-login  **No code has been changed.** I did a read-only pass over the whole chain first, because the ticket's working theory ("client-side wiring bug") should be checked before proposing a fix.  ### What I found reading the code - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` always fetches/saves via the API (`api.get`/`api.post`/`api.delete` on `/watchlist...`). No `localStorage`/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist code. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie goes out correct
